# Check if Lukáš Melich's highest finish was as a junior
# Define junior competitions based on typical naming in the table
junior_keywords = ['junior', 'u23', 'universiade']  # Including U23 and Universiade as they are age-group events
# Filter rows where competition contains any junior keyword
junior_mask = df['competition'].str.contains('|'.join(junior_keywords), case=False, na=False)
junior_df = df[junior_mask]

# Find the best (highest) position in junior competitions
# Convert position strings to numeric by extracting the number part (e.g., "10th" -> 10)
junior_df['position_numeric'] = junior_df['position'].str.extract(r'(\d+)').astype(float)
best_junior_position = junior_df['position_numeric'].min()

# Find the best (highest) position overall
df['position_numeric'] = df['position'].str.extract(r'(\d+)').astype(float)
best_overall_position = df['position_numeric'].min()

# Determine the competition type where the best overall position occurred
best_overall_row = df.loc[df['position_numeric'] == best_overall_position]
best_overall_competition = best_overall_row['competition'].iloc[0]

# Check if the best overall competition is a junior competition
answer = bool(junior_mask.loc[best_overall_row.index].any())
